mutations.label: shard: each slice registers its own tests, not the first slice's
mutations.from: const slice = (...args) => (index++ % of === shard ? test(...args) : undefined)
mutations.only: ^(?:sharded, every top-level test is registered by exactly one shard)$

mutations.label: shard: unsharded, the file is plain test and registers every test
mutations.only: ^(?:unsharded, the file registers every test, whichever shard asks)$
